item.title: The EBA consults on revised technical standards for joint decisions on institution-specific capital and liquidity requirements
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today started a public consultation on proposed revisions to the Implementing Technical Standards (ITS) governing the joint decision process for institution-specific prudential requirements foreseen by Article 113 of the Capital Requirements Directive. The revisions are part of the EBA’s broader efforts to simplify and enhance the efficiency of the regulatory and supervisory framework, as outlined in its Report on the efficiency of the regulatory and supervisory framework, published in October 2025. — Thématique finance ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact réglementaire.

item.title: EU/EEA banks display strength amid a challenging risk environment
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its Risk Dashboard for the second quarter of 2026.
